newsitems.title: Ver. 4.2 Update Information
newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Content[/h2][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/f11747441ee3abacf9270cad4357bc6487d5e97f.png"][/img]• P3R Special Event: Met by Moonlight: Pierce the Night Sky[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jun 11, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/ba4c8f0b4c1c60ed5e7ca13ee1db946b86ecc2b8.png"][/img][/p][h3]• 5★ Yukari Takeba comes to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts![/h3][p]Duration: Until Jun 25, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Trials from the Sea of Souls[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jun 11, 2026 at 1:29 AM (UTC)[/p][p]Ver. 4.2's Trials from the Sea of Souls will run for one week.[/p][p]We will be adjusting the rewards accordingly to match this duration.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/961e277ce03916a3d0658336780b853284c11882.png"][/img]
• New Thieves Den Features[/h3][p]You can now collect any earned Visitor EXP and P Medals in the Thieves Den without going to the Visitors or Information menus.
[/p][h3]• Assist Phantom Thief Capacity Increased[/h3][p]You will now be able to set up to two Assist Phantom Thieves.
[/p][h3]• Boss Difficulty Options[/h3][p]You will now be able to lower the difficulty of Strong Enemies and Bosses in Palaces 1, 2, and 3.[/p][p]If you are Defeated or choose to Retreat, the option to change the difficulty will become available.[/p][p]*Please note: Once you lower the difficulty, you will not be able to reset it to normal difficulty.[/p][h3]
• Gameplay Changes[/h3][p]　▽ Gates of the Nightmare Catcher[/p][p]　┗ When a member leaves their Companio, any points they have contributed towards the total for that Companio's ranking will be reset.[/p][p]　┗ When a new member transfers from another Companio, that member's points in the Companio's ranking (including their player points) will now start at 0.[/p][p]　　*Badge rewards obtained from personal achievements are not reset.[/p][p]　　*Stage rewards for player point milestones can still be claimed even after leaving a Companio.
[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Joy Medal Exchange[/h3][p]Added the Wonder-exclusive weapon Cyclotron and Cyclotron Shards, the special crystals used to forge it, to the Joy Medal Exchange.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/8d842eaabb3af70b6537e19ea772aa90637d5b96.png"][/img][/p][h3]• New Lineup of Crane Game Limited-Time Plushies![/h3][p]Available Until: Jul 16, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ Plushies[/p][p]　└ Ganesha[/p][p]　└ Mini Succubus[/p][p]*Also available from the Prize Counter, under the Crane Game menu.[/p][p]*Alice and Mini Decarabia plushies will be available until the start of maintenance on Jun 4.
[/p][h3]• New additions to the Tycoon Points Exchange[/h3][p]　▽ New Items[/p][p]　└ Kamiyama's Invite[/p][p]　└ Yumi's Invite[/p][p]　└ Kotone ♦7[/p][p]　└ Kurotani ♣3[/p][p]　└ Shoki ♣2
[/p][p]*The above were previously planned for Ver. 4.3, as covered on the Persona X-stream #19, but will instead be included in Ver. 4.2.[/p][h3]
• Side Story Unlocked [/h3][p]　▽ New Side Story: [/p][p]　└ Toshiya Sumi[/p][p]  [/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

[h2]Content[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/0930b4a8e33df5924d5bbaa2967880809958f1ef.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Main Story Chapter 4: The Masks We Wear: Phase 1 is here![/h3][p]The following content has been added alongside the release of the latest part of the Main Story.[/p][p]　Content added:[/p][p]　┗4★ Phantom Thief Shoki Ikenami, along with his exclusive weapons (including 5★)[/p][p]　└Palaces: New Areas[/p][p]　└Mementos: New Areas[/p][p]　The Masks We Wear: Phase 1 Release Event[/p][p]　Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Jun 11, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]　*More details will be shared in a future announcement.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/640557d75d9d871621502d4815132d76a66ce03e.png"][/img]• Event: Tycoon Typhoon[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on May 21, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]This is a 4-player card game where the winner is the one who discards their hand the fastest.[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Special Login Bonus: Anniversary Countdown[/h3][p]Duration: For 60 days after your first log in before 1:59 AM on Jul 16, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]As a lead up to our first anniversary in June, a special login bonus will be held.[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.

[/p][h3]• New Protagonist-exclusive weapon: Pheromone Sting[/h3][p]In the exploration rewards for the new Mementos areas and Chapter 4's Palace in the main story, the Protagonist's exclusive weapon Pheromone Sting and the special Shards used to forge it, Pheromone Sting Shard, will appear.[/p][p]Furthermore, Pheromone Sting Shard will be added to the lineups in the Companio Coin Exchange Shop and the Star Crystal Exchange Shop.[/p][h3]

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/606bcbf8352a48dab8950a900a9aaf57535a30a7.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Phantom Pass update[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Jun 11, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Complete the new seasonal missions to earn rewards.[/p][p]*With the season change, the EXP and level of the currently active pass will be reset at 9:59 PM on Apr 29, 2026 (UTC).
[/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

newsitems.title: P5R's Kasumi Yoshizawa debuts!
newsitems.author: s.omae
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Content[/h2][h3]・Meet the 5★ Phantom Thief: Kasumi Yoshizawa (Code name: Violet)![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/6dec12b14130efab55347eff5b265d06482175b5.jpg"][/img]Kasumi Yoshizawa is a 5★ Bless Assassin. [/p][p]When activating her Highlight, she does not spend the Highlight gauge and can inflict critical hits. [/p][p]She can increase her own Attack alongside an ally’s, and has a buff that applies whenever an ally activates a Highlight. [/p][p]Her 5★ Weapon increases her critical damage. Additionally, when an ally activates a Highlight, Kasumi’s own Highlight increases in damage. [/p][p]Pair her up with other characters that can buff Highlights, and fire them off consecutively. Each Highlight powers up Kasumi, allowing her to deal massive damage to the enemy. [/p][p]Duration: From the end of maintenance on Mar 19, 2026 (Thu) until 1:59 AM on Apr 16, 2026 (Thu) (UTC)[/p][p]Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts: Most Wanted Phantom Thieves Introduction[/p][p]5★ Phantom Thief: Kasumi Yoshizawa[/p][p]4★ Phantom Thief: Tomoko Noge[/p][p]4★ Phantom Thief: Kiyoshi Kurotani[/p][p]4★ Phantom Thief: Motoha Arai[/p][p][/p][h3]• Event: Crossroads of Fate: Laboratory Arc Part 1[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/ccc739e2b9a1cff7fa6e3fb861fadb24c6b184fc.jpg"][/img]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Apr 2, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Event: Tycoon Typhoon[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/f8f983d32f7200f0e70e3831438a60f45dd7b9cd.png"][/img][/p][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Apr 2, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]This is a 4-player card game where the winner is the one who discards their hand the fastest.[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Login Bonus[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/c18f02e8fa3e4507c18029857eac22457f4b3175.png"][/img]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Apr 2, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]During the event period, log in for 7 days to get 7 Platinum Milicoin!
[/p][h3]• New additions to the Repression Medal Exchange[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/0909aafe9983486ea16a2bc41d4501d2dbb9288b.png"][/img]Rank VIII Persona Sraosha added to the Repression Medal IV Exchange Shop.[/p][p]Additionally, Rank VII Persona Siegfried and Rank VIII Persona Nian Shou are now also available at the Repression Medal IV Exchange Shop.
[/p][h3]• Gameplay Changes[/h3][p]　▽ Assist Phantom Thieves and Gates of the Nightmare Catcher[/p][p]　┗ Assist Phantom Thieves for new members who have transferred from another Companio will now only be usable from the start of the following season.[/p][p]　▽ Displaying Availability Period in Shops[/p][p]　┗ The Remaining Days displayed in shops will be changed from rounding up to rounding down. For the exact availability period of any Limited-Time Offers, please see the Pack Details screen. 
[/p][h3]• Skill Adjustments [/h3][p]We have adjusted the below skills to expand their usability. [/p][p]　▽ 5★ Phantom Thief Mio Natsukawa’s Awareness Level 6 Effect[/p][p]Before: If foes are Burning on Natsukawa's action, activate Sub-Zero Torrent on that foe 1 time (this effect will not be activated by Scald).[/p][p]After: If foes are Burning or Scalded on Natsukawa's action, activate Sub-Zero Torrent on that foe 1 time.[/p][p]　▽ Inferno of Nothingness Forge Details for the Protagonist-exclusive weapon, Purgatory[/p][p] Before: At the start of battle, gain 2 Trial by Fire stacks. When an ally deals Fire skill damage to a foe, gain 1 Trial by Fire stack. At the start of the user's turn, lose 1 Trial by Fire stack.[/p][p]Inferno of Nothingness: Gain the following effects based on the number of Trial by Fire stacks. Stacks up to 3 times.[/p][p]After: At the start of battle, gain 2 Trial by Fire stacks. When an ally deals Fire skill damage to a foe, gain 1 Trial by Fire stack. Trial by Fire lasts 3 turns and stacks up to 3 times.[/p][p] Inferno of Nothingness: Gain the following effects based on the number of Trial by Fire stacks.[/p][p][/p][h3]• New Bonds[/h3][p]　└Mayumi Hashimoto[/p][p][/p][h3]• City Life Updates[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/b79027cbfce51d9a02d7abad63f694409c48eae3.png"][/img]　└(New)Café Leblanc: Kasumi Yoshizawa [/p][h3]• Phantom Pass update[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/73f35868d996951f7c4c7dd139d2dd327aa87f11.png"][/img]Season Duration: From the end of maintenance on Mar 19, 2026 until 1:59 AM on Apr 30, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Complete the new seasonal missions to earn rewards.[/p][p]*With the season change, the EXP and level of the currently active pass will be reset at 1:59 AM on Mar 19, 2026 (UTC).
[/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Mar 19, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.[/p][p][/p][h3]• New Special Outfit for the Protagonist![/h3][p]Get the Special Outfit: Lunar New Year Wonder under Shop > Goods![/p][p]The Lunar New Year Wonder Outfit will be visible during battles and while exploring Palaces,[/p][p]as well as in the animations for All-out Attacks and Highlights.[/p][p]To celebrate the release of this special outfit, we're holding a special sale until 1:59 AM on Apr 2, 2026 (UTC)![/p][p]During the sale, the amount of Meta Jewels required will be reduced from 3,600 to 3,240![/p][p]*Outfit can still be purchased after 1:59 AM on Apr 2, 2026 (UTC).[/p][p]*Check in-game for more details.[/p][p][/p][h3]• Special Login Bonuses during Lunar New Year [/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Apr 2, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Log in during the event period to receive a Lunar Firecrackers frame. Log in for seven days to get a total of 10 Platinum Tickets.[/p][p]And if you log in for 14 days, you can collect a Lunar Lanterns profile design and other great rewards!  [/p][p][/p][h3]• New ways to obtain 5★ Phantom Thief Yumi Shiina and her exclusive weapon[/h3][p]We've added multiple new ways to get Yumi and her weapon, including through Phantom Idol Draft X, Thief's Cognitite Shards, a 5★ Cognitite Case, and the Salamander Coin Exchange.[/p][p]*Salamander Coins can be traded for 5★ Weapons at the Airsoft Shop in Shibuya.[/p][p][/p][h3]• Changes to certain weapons[/h3][p]When Phantom Thieves who have previously appeared are reintroduced under a different name, like Firecracker Yaoling, they will only be able to equip their own exclusive weapons (in this case, weapons for Firecracker Yaoling), even if they have the same code name as before. Please refer to the item description for each weapon to confirm which Phantom Thief it is for.     [/p][p]*Applies to upcoming weapons only. Weapons previously introduced can continue to be equipped by variant versions of Phantom Thieves.[/p][p][/p][h3]• New additions to the Joy Medal Exchange[/h3][p]Added the Wonder-exclusive weapon Purgatory and Purgatory Shards, the special crystals used to forge it, to the Joy Medal Exchange. [/p][p][/p][h3]• New additions to the Repression Medal Exchange[/h3][p]Skill Cards have been newly added to the Repression Medal II and Repression Medal III exchanges.[/p][p]Skill Cards are used in Persona Training, allowing you to teach a Persona a specific skill.[/p][p]However, each Skill Card has conditions that must be met for a Persona to learn it. Please check the Skill Card descriptions for details. [/p][p][/p][h3]• Limited-Time Chinese Lion Dance Capsule Toy Available in Kichijoji![/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Apr 30, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Find the limited-time capsule toys as you enjoy the Lunar New Year celebrations![/p][p][/p][h3]• New Lineup of Crane Game Limited-Time Plushies![/h3][p]Available until 1:59 AM on Apr 16, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ Plushies[/p][p]　└ Black Frost[/p][p]　└ Mini Jack-o'-Lantern[/p][p]*Also available from the Prize Counter, under the Crane Game menu.[/p][p]*Mini Jack Frost and Pixie plushies will be available until the start of maintenance on Mar 4.[/p][p][/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

newsitems.title: 29th D.I.C.E. Awards: Mobile Game of the Year Celebratory Gift
newsitems.author: P5X_EN
newsitems.contents:
[p align="start"]Thank you for playing Persona5: The Phantom X. [/p][p align="start"]We are pleased to announce that P5X has won the Mobile Game of the Year category at the 29th D.I.C.E. Awards, the world's premier awards event for game developers and industry professionals. 
The Operations Team would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to you all. 
To celebrate this award, we will be sending out a special D.I.C.E. Awards Celebratory Gift! [/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]D.I.C.E. Awards Celebratory Gift [/b]
[b]Claim by: The start of maintenance on Mar 5, 2026[/b]
The following items will be sent to your Mail.[/p][p align="start"][b]Gifts:[/b]
Gold Ticket x10 
(Eligible Users) 
Accounts registered before 1:59 AM on Mar 5, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p align="start"]*Important Notes* 
• You can claim this gift from your in-game Mail. 
• Gifts will be removed from your Mail after the receipt period ends regardless of whether or not they have been claimed. Please be sure to claim them within the designated period. 
• The content and duration are subject to change without prior notice. [/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]About the D.I.C.E. Awards [/b]
D.I.C.E. is an acronym for the following four words. 
Design 
Innovate 
Communicate 
Entertain 
Arranged by the Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences (AIAS), the awards are voted on by creators and professionals in the game industry. [/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]D.I.C.E. Awards official site[/b][/p][p][url="https://www.interactive.org/awards/"]https://www.interactive.org/awards/[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We would not have been able to receive this prestigious award without the support of all P5X fans out there and the entire Operations Team would like to express our heartfelt gratitude. 
We share Persona5: The Phantom X-related announcements, campaign information, and more on our official social media. 
Be sure to follow us for all the latest news. [/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]■Official Social Media Accounts[/b]
Official X Account: [url="https://www.x.com/P5XOfficialWest"]https://www.x.com/P5XOfficialWest[/url][/p][p align="start"]Official Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/P5XOfficialWest"]https://www.facebook.com/P5XOfficialWest[/url][/p][p align="start"]Official Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/P5XOfficialWest"]https://www.instagram.com/P5XOfficialWest[/url][/p][p align="start"]Official Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/sCjMhC2Ttu"]https://discord.gg/sCjMhC2Ttu[/url][/p][p align="start"]Official Youtube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@P5XOfficialWest"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Persona5: The Phantom X Operations Team[/b][/p]
